## Outcome

Describe the user-visible or architectural outcome.

## Scope

- [ ] Every changed line belongs to this PR’s objective.
- [ ] No unrelated refactor is included.

## Validation

- [ ] `./Scripts/check.sh`
- [ ] Swift coverage is at least 90%.
- [ ] Chromium extension coverage is at least 90%.
- [ ] Required real integration checks were run, or the missing external dependency is documented as a blocker.

## Privacy and permissions

- [ ] No screenshot, DOM content, API key, or model payload is persisted or logged.
